## Research question

What is the fair per-share value of Idorsia (SIX: IDIA) when its clinical pipeline is valued product by product using phase-weighted probabilities of success, and how does that fair value compare to the current market capitalisation?

## Summary

**Method**: Risk-adjusted NPV. Each pipeline product is projected as a revenue curve (ramp → peak → plateau → patent cliff), converted into operating cash flows via a time-varying operating margin, discounted at a biotech WACC (mid-year convention), and probability-weighted using BIO/Informa/QLS 2011-2020 phase-to-phase transitions. Development costs follow the same probability chain: the current phase is certain, each future phase is weighted by the cumulative probability of reaching it. Parent-attributable equity value = Σ product rNPVs + parent net cash − PV of unallocated central costs. Per-share value is floored at zero (limited liability).

**Scope**: QUVIVIQ (daridorexant, marketed), lucerastat (Phase 3, Fabry disease), and three Phase 2 candidates (CCR6, CXCR7, CXCR3 antagonists). The three assets transferred in 2025 to the ring-fenced Idorsia Investments SARL (aprocitentan, selatogrel, cenerimod) are excluded from the base case and treated as an option-like residual, see [Methodology](methodology.qmd) §*Structural note*.

**Main finding**: Base case fair value floored at **CHF `{python} f"{BASE:.2f}"` / share** (raw equity value `{python} f"CHF {BRIDGE['equity_value_chf_m']:+,.0f} M"` pre-floor) vs market **CHF `{python} f"{MARKET:.2f}"`** (IDIA.SW close `{python} MARKET_AS_OF`). The gap decomposes into **two catalysts** the base case excludes — (1) a residual claim on the ring-fenced SARL assets, (2) a QUVIVIQ blockbuster trajectory above base-case peak — **plus one refinancing event** the base case already treats as pure debt: the CHF `{python} f"{A.JJ_CONVERTIBLE_PRINCIPAL_CHF_M:.0f}"` M J&J convertible loan maturing **15 June 2027**, convertible into `{python} f"{A.JJ_CONVERTIBLE_SHARES_ON_CONVERSION_M:.1f}"` M shares at CHF `{python} f"{A.JJ_CONVERTIBLE_STRIKE_CHF:.2f}"` (strike well above current market) — never an upside, either dilution if we rerate materially, or a cash repayment.

**Reconciled fair-value range across scenarios: CHF `{python} f"{RANGE_LO:.2f}"` – `{python} f"{RANGE_HI:.2f}"` / share** (post-floor, post-if-converted). See the full note in [Results](results.qmd).
